task.description:
Fix memory leaks in API-07 validation module (src/api/validation.zig).

REWORK 1: Previous implementation passes all 36 test assertions but has 8 memory leaks causing zig build test to exit 1.

Issues:
- [BLOCKER] validate() `.ok` path leaks internal arena from parseFromValue (2 leaks in TC-API-07-06)
- [BLOCKER] validate() `.errors` path leaks internal arena + serialisation (4 leaks in TC-API-07-07)
- [BLOCKER] enforceValidation() `.ok` path leaks internal arena (2 leaks in TC-API-07-07b)

Root cause: parseFromValue with .alloc_always creates an internal ArenaAllocator that is never freed (src/api/validation.zig:367).

Fix: Ensure the arena from parseFromValue is deinit'd after use, or copy parsed values to caller-owned memory before deinit.

Acceptance criteria:
- zig build exits 0
- zig build test exits 0 (0 leaks)
- All 36 API-07 test assertions still pass
acceptance_criteria: zig build test exits 0 with 0 memory leaks

result.summary: Fixed 8 memory leaks in API-07 validation module. Root cause was parseFromValue with .alloc_always creating an internal ArenaAllocator never freed on the .ok path, and field_errors allocations not freed in enforceValidation() on the .errors path. Fix: (1) Added dupeValue() generic deep-copy function that copies string fields from the arena to the caller's allocator before deiniting the arena; (2) Added defer-based field_errors cleanup in enforceValidation() after serialisation. Updated TC-API-07-06 and TC-API-07-07b tests to free caller-owned strings.
